selection: All baseline core_ids with nonempty reasoning from all four exposing models; no per-task cap
positions: Complete raw whitespace-token windows at beginning, middle and end; identical offsets deduplicated; arithmetic mean per trace
pair_eligibility: All four models must have at least width tokens; exclude incomplete windows; each question contributes one row per model
bootstrap_unit: task then question within task, paired across all models
annotation_status: AI-assisted initial coding; independent human annotation and agreement pending
correctness: Excluded from revised objectives and inferential analysis; retained as original corpus metadata
constructs: Brevity=observed whitespace-token length; zlib ratio=algorithmic regularity; linguistic shortening=annotated grammatical and symbolic phenomena; no human readability measure
